'''Qigong Kesh''', or the '''Temple of Force Skills''', was one of nine temples of the [[Je'daii Order]] located on the verdant [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. Located among the dunes of the [[Silent Desert]] on the continent of [[Thyr]],<ref name="DOTJ:ITV">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref> the Temple known as Qigong Kesh served as the Order's academy for enhancing and improving one's mental and sensory skills with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].

==History==
When the philosophers and scholars from across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] first arrived on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], they were brought forth from the stars in giant pyramidal constructs called the [[Tho Yor]]. These nine massive ships scattered across the planet and landed in separate locations, releasing those held within to settle the planet. The Tho Yor themselves would serve as the foundations for these travelers' new homes and places of study.<ref name="DOTJ0" />

One of the Tho Yor lingered in the [[Silent Desert]], where the first members of the [[Je'daii Order]] founded the Temple of Force Skills at Qigong Kesh. Beneath the still landscape, caverns stretched outward, shielded from the muting properties of the sands. The temple's students would focus on enhancing their mental endurance and strength in the silence of the desert, focusing on [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and learning to shield themselves within it. The [[Je'daii Temple Master]], the Je'daii who served as steward of the facility and oversaw its functions, would see that all students maintained proper balance at the temple and kept to their studies. In [[25,793 BBY]] Master [[Miarta Sek]], a [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]], was the Temple's overseer.<ref name="DOTJ0" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Wikipedia:Qigong|Qigong]] is a Chinese practice of meditation.
